exposure: maternal ingestion of corn-based preparations (green corn cakes and sweet hominies)
cohort: The study included 35 mother-infant pairs, where mothers experienced hypogalactia and/or had infants in neonatal and pediatric intensive care units, often being mothers of premature children with low birth weights.
finding: Maternal ingestion of corn-based preparations significantly increased the average volume of expressed human milk from 343.6 mL/day at baseline to 397.6 mL/day during the intervention (p < 0.001).
